Name. The model must be named "Mythos" (e.g., "Claude Mythos 5"). Public release. A release restricted to a closed beta or to a limited set of approved or trusted organizations does not constitute a release to the public. A release available to the general public, including a release limited to a paid subscription tier, does constitute a release to the public.
